cause: BLU cannot safely forget an unresolved bank statement command after a reload or later eligibility change. The SDK had exact historical replay but no terminal fence for an unaccepted statement command.
changes: Add public bankStatements.retireCommandAttempt for prepare/complete/reopen/cancel; original input and separate same-actor cancellation operation are immutable and payload-bound.

Use existing source lock and original lifecycle key. A terminal cancellation event makes delayed normal replay conflict, including the pre-change writer path. No extra financial table, ledger, balance, posting or statement status.

Accepted commands return original historical statement and separate currentStatement without writes; unaccepted commands check original account/book/source provenance without current version/fiscal eligibility.

Share command normalization between execution and retirement, preserving existing exact-money and bounded sorted selection behavior. Export types from both package entry points and add BLU public consumer compile coverage.

foreign scope rejection and immutable retirement evidence
historical accepted receipts/current state separated with DML rejected
fiscal closing/stale version does not strand cancellation
eight real PostgreSQL waiter races, each action and both winners
outer rollback and lost commit acknowledgement
actual owned backend termination after receipt insert before commit
existing statement exact-money, selection, cancel/reopen, pagination, immutable evidence and close/completion races
